tasks.title: Docker Fundamentals and Container Management
steps: 1. Do you know how to install and configure Docker?
2. Can you explain the architecture of Docker?
3. What are the main components of Docker?
4. What are the different objects managed by the Docker host?
5. What is the purpose of a Docker registry?
6. Which Linux kernel features does Docker use in the background?
7. Which command is used to check the installed Docker version?
8. Which command is used to inspect the details of a Docker container?
9. What is a Docker image?
10. Where are Docker images downloaded from?
11. How can you check whether a particular Docker image is already available on your system?
12. Which command is used to remove a Docker image?
13. Which command can be used to remove all unused Docker images with a single command?
14. What is the difference between a Docker image and a container?
15. Can one Docker image be used to create multiple containers?
16. What is the purpose of the docker pull command?
17. What is the difference between docker run and docker start?
18. What is the difference between interactive mode and detached mode?
19. What is the difference between the -it and -d options?
20. What is the purpose of the -i and -t options?
21. Which command is used to start a container in detached mode?
22. Which command is used to start a container in interactive mode?
23. How can you create a container with a specific name?
24. How can you create a named container and publish its port at the same time?
25. Which command is used to start an existing container?
26. Which command is used to stop a running container?
27. Which command is used to remove a container?
28. Does removing a container also remove its associated image?
29. Which command is used to view the logs of a Docker container?
30. Can multiple containers be created from the same Docker image?
31. Why do we need to publish ports when running Docker containers?
32. What does -p 8080:80 mean in a Docker command?
33. Can multiple containers use the same internal port, such as port 80?
34. Can two containers publish their internal port 80 to the same host port?
35. Which command can you use to verify the published ports of a container?
36. What is the difference between docker ps and docker ps -a?
37. Where is the default HTML document root directory of Nginx inside a Docker container?
38. What is Docker volume?
39. Why do we need volumes in Docker?
40. What is the difference between a Docker volume and a container's writable layer?
41. What is a bind mount in Docker?
42. What is the difference between a volume and a bind mount?
43. Where are Docker volumes stored on the host?
44. Where is the data stored when we use a bind mount?
45. What happens to container data when a container is removed?
46. Why is data persistence important in Docker?
47. Can multiple containers use the same Docker volume?
48. What is a Union Filesystem?
49. What is OverlayFS?
50. Why does Docker use OverlayFS?
51. What is Copy-on-Write?
52. Why is data lost when a Docker container is removed, but data stored in a Docker volume persists?
53. Which command is used to create a Docker volume?
54. How can you list all Docker volumes?
55. How can you inspect a Docker volume?
56. How can you remove a Docker volume?
57. What is the purpose of the docker volume prune command?
58. Can we create a volume without running a container?
59. What happens if we use a volume name that does not exist with docker run?
60. How can you identify which volume is attached to a container?
61. Can we attach multiple volumes to a single container?
62. What is the difference between named volumes and anonymous volumes?
63. Which option is used to configure a bind mount with docker run?
64. What is the purpose of the -v option?
65. What is the purpose of the --mount option?
66. What is the difference between -v and --mount?
67. How can you mount a directory as read-only inside a container?
68. How would you preserve MySQL database data even after removing its container?
69. How would you share a website's HTML files between the host and an Nginx container?
70. How can you mount /data from the host to /var/www/html inside a container?
71. How can you ensure that a container can read data but cannot modify it?
72. If you delete a container, will its named volume also be deleted?
73. What is Docker networking, and why do we need it?
74. What are the different network drivers available in Docker?
75. What is the default network driver used by Docker when you start a standalone container without specifying a network?
76. What is the difference between the default bridge network and a user-defined bridge network?
77. What is the purpose of the docker0 interface on a Docker host?
78. What is a Docker bridge network? How does it work?
79. What is the difference between bridge networking and host networking?
80. What happens when you run a container with the none network driver?
81. What is an overlay network, and when would you use it?
82. What is Docker's embedded DNS service, and what is its purpose?
83. What is the difference between a container's IP address and the Docker host's IP address?
84. Can a Docker container be connected to multiple networks simultaneously? Explain.
85. Which command lists all Docker networks?
86. How do you create a user-defined bridge network named app-network?
87. How do you inspect a Docker network to view its subnet, gateway, and connected containers?
88. How do you start a container and attach it to a specific network?
89. How do you connect an existing container to another Docker network?
90. How do you disconnect a running container from a Docker network?
91. How do you remove a Docker network?
92. How do you remove all unused Docker networks?
93. How do you publish container port 80 on host port 8080?
94. How do you check the IP address assigned to a Docker container?
95. How can you check which network a particular container is connected to?
96. How do you run a container using host networking?
